evidence.reason: The assertion at lines 173-174 strips the first character of every encoded line before comparing, so any one-character prefix, including '-' or a space, would still pass. It therefore does not verify the intended '+' added-line prefix after the U+0085 split; the separate lone-CR assertion uses different input. This is a minor test correctness gap, and comparing against ['+' + line for line in text.splitlines()] is the smallest compatible fix.
